design.purpose: A raised patio planter for herbs or one small shrub, filled to about 17 cm deep with compost over drained base planks.

steps.c: Lay the wide board flat for marking
Measure and mark 29 cm sections
Saw the wide board into planter sides
Lay the medium board flat for marking
Measure and mark base and feet
Saw out the base plank and feet
Lay the narrow board flat for marking
Measure and mark the rear base plank
Saw out the rear base plank
Stand the first foot across the footprint
Stand the second foot beside the first
Lay the front base across both feet
Lay the rear base touching the front
Drill 10 mm drainage holes in front base
Drill 10 mm drainage holes in rear base
Drive screws through front base into foot
Drive screws through front base into foot
Drive screws through rear base into foot
Drive screws through rear base into foot
Stand the front side on the base
Stand the back side on the base
Fit the left end between the sides
Fit the right end between the sides
Drill 3 mm pilot holes at corners
Drive screws through front into left end
Drive screws through front into right end
Drive screws through back into left end
Drive screws through back into right end
Drive screws through front side into base
Drive screws through back side into base
Sand cut edges and corners lightly
